text: The prince who has his people armed and trained for war, should always await a great and dangerous war at home, and never go forth to meet it. But that he whose subjects are unarmed, and whose country is not habituated to war, should always carry the war to as great a distance as he can from home.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
